rationale: This revision supplies strict greater-than against earlier candidates and at-least against later candidates, unlike the initial >=-all predicate that included self. Nonfinite encoding is unresolved but no executable finite-only admission condition is declared. Bind the literal earlier/later predicate with guard True; fixed row state does not mean finite-valued state. Declared verification and fallback do not establish the local predicate or complete migration.

interpretations.meaning: Candidate strictly exceeds every earlier absolute pivot and is at least every later absolute pivot, with no stated state exclusion.
interpretations.expression: all(values[i] > values[j] for j in indices if j < i) and all(values[i] >= values[k] for k in indices if k > i)
